description.en: Aluminum Feruchemy allows you to store your spiritual Identity in your aluminummind.

**Prerequisite** Insight 2+.

Forgo a long rest to gain the downtime benefits of Self-Reflection. Additionally, while tapping Identity, your deflect applies to spirit damage.
While tapping Identity, recover 1 focus on turns where you act in accordance with your purpose, obstacle, or goals.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Identity and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to avoid being grazed by attacks vs. Spiritual.
Through Atium Feruchemy, you can store your youth in your atiummind.

**Prerequisite** Deception 2+.

Gain an advantage on tests using Presence to influence characters in your current age category.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While chronologically Middle-Aged or older, spend 2 charges to momentarily become Young and Enhanced [+1 to all].
Bendalloy Feruchemy allows you to store nutrition and hydration in your bendalloymind.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Tap Nutrition and spend additional charges to instead recover health and reduce your Exhausted penalty.

**Prerequisite** Medicine 2+.

**Spend 1 charge** from your bendalloymind to reroll one die from your test (other than the plot die) that rolled lower than your ranks in Feruchemy.

**Prerequisite** Medicine 3+.

Store an ingestible curative in your bendalloymind. When you later spend that charge, you gain the curative's benefits.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

If your rerolled die for Proactive Nutrition is still lower, replace one die with your ranks in Feruchemy.

**Prerequisite** Medicine 4+.

Store an ingestible poison in your bendalloymind, then later spend that charge to temporarily succeed on tests to resist it.
Brass Feruchemy enables the storing of your body's warmth in your brassmind.
Grapple, Shove, or make an unarmed attack while tapping warmth. If you succeed or graze the target, deal additional energy damage.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping warmth, touch a character and deal energy damage.

**Prerequisite** Medicine 2+.

While storing or tapping warmth, add your ranks in Feruchemy to an ally's recovery die. Additionally, forgo a long rest to speed an injured ally's recovery.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While storing warmth, **spend 2 focus** or opportunity to make a target you're touching become Diminished [Speed −2].

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Before something occurs that could be affected by storing or tapping warmth, **spend 1 focus** to do so.
Tap Warmth and spend additional charges to shorten its effects, and to exude ambient heat that deals energy damage.
You can use Bronze Feruchemy to store wakefulness in your bronzemind; this is the only known Feruchemical trait that can be stored while sleeping.
Spend 1 charge to become Enhanced [Intellect +1] and Enhanced [Awareness +1].

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Store charges without sleeping, becoming Exhausted [−2]. Remove the Focused condition to gain an additional charge.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

**Spend 1 charge** to become Focused until the end of your next turn.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

**Spend charges** to immediately gain the recovery benefits of one short rest per charge spent.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

**Spend 5 charges** to immediately gain the benefits of a long rest.
Through Cadmium Feruchemy, you can store breath.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+

Tap Breath and spend charges to reduce the focus cost of reaction and free action by the number of charges spent.

**Prerequisite** Athletics 2+.

Your Tap Breath duration doubles. While not tapping or storing, your first reaction or free action in a scene costs 1 fewer focus.
While you're Afflicted or Disoriented, spend 1 charge to remove that condition.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

This power reduces the focus cost of all actions, not just reaction and free action.

**Prerequisite** Athletics 3+.

When you recover health and / or focus while tapping breath, recover additional equal to your ranks in Feruchemy.
Chromium Feruchemy grants the ability to store spiritual Fortune in your chromiummind.
When the GM raises the stakes, you can stop tapping Fortune to store it, test without raised stakes, and regain 1 charge.
After a rest, spend 1 charge to feel how impactful the upcoming scene will be, and become Focused when an important person, place, or moment arrives.

**Prerequisite** Leadership 2+.

Before an ally makes a test while you're tapping Fortune, spend 1 charge to raise the stakes.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping Fortune, use the Ready action as free action.

**Prerequisite** Insight 2+.

When a scene begins, spend charges to Move once for each charge spent.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Spend charges to increase your opportunity and complication ranges by 1 + charges spent, and raise the stakes on all tests.
Copper Feruchemy allows you to store and retrieve memories from your coppermind.
Store an expertise with Store Memory. When you Tap Memory to recall it, gain an advantage on related cognitive and spiritual tests.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Tap Memory and spend charges to recall the memories connected to each charge.
After a rest spent working toward an expertise, store that expertise in your coppermind.

**Prerequisite** Agility 2+ or Athletics 2+.

When you Tap Memory to recall an expertise, gain an advantage on related physical tests.

**Prerequisite** Lore 2+.

Your Copper Feruchemy effects that usually last for 1 scene instead last until after a long rest.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+; Lore 3+.

Your coppermind's max charges increase by 5, and your Intellect increases by 2.
Through Duralumin Feruchemy, you can store spiritual Connection.
When you Store Connection, choose which characters to exempt. When you gain a language from Tap Connection, it lasts until you tap another.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping Connection, resisting your influence costs an additional 2 focus.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Spend 2 charges to test Feruchemy vs. a non-enemy's Spiritual; on success, they temporarily become your friend.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

It costs you one fewer action to use Instant Bond. Additionally, **Instant Bond** can also target Minion enemies.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Connection and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to make resisting your influence cost additional focus.
Electrum Feruchemy enables you to store determination in your electrummind.
The first time you Tap Determination, either become Determined or ignore a temporary injury.
While storing determination, resisting influence costs 1 focus more, but you gain an advantage on Insight and Persuasion.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping determination, spend opportunity to make yourself and your allies Determined and your enemies Exhausted [−1].

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

When you choose to regain consciousness, spend charges and roll a recovery die for each charge spent.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Determination and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to ignore your injuries.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While storing determination, when you choose not to resist influence, recover 2 focus and learn key information.
Through Gold Feruchemy, you can store health in your goldmind.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Tap Health to heal yourself from temporary injuries, and spend additional charges to heal permanent ones.
Tap Health to avoid becoming Unconscious and immediately recover health.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Spend charges to recover some health.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

Spend 5 charges to recover all health, heal your injuries, and end the effects of diseases, drugs, and poisons.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Disengage as part of Reflexive Bloodmaker, and gain reaction for Reflexive Bloodmaker each turn.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While Unconscious or recently dead, Tap Health as free action.
Iron Feruchemy enables you to store your physical weight in your ironmind.
While tapping weight, make a melee weapon or unarmed attack, dealing extra damage and pushing smaller targets.
While storing weight, reduce impact and keen damage by your Feruchemy, then move 10 feet without Reactive Strikes.
After a smaller character hits you with a melee attack, knock them Prone.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Weight and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects.

**Prerequisite** Agility 2+.

While storing weight, gain an advantage on non-attack tests using Speed, and jump much farther without a test.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Before an action or event that could be affected by storing or tapping weight, spend 1 focus to Store or Tap Weight.
Through Nicrosil Feruchemy, you can store your very ability to wield Investiture.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping strength, your deflect increases, you can Brace without cover, and you count as cover for allies.

**Prerequisite** Heavy Weaponry 1+ or Light Weaponry 1+.

While burning pewter or tapping strength, replace your melee weapon's damage with your unarmed damage dice.
While tapping strength, you and allies benefitting from your Wall of Muscle ignore Pierce.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Strength and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to increase your size by one category.
While burning pewter or tapping strength, weapons gain Thrown [100/300]. When they're thrown, you can use your unarmed damage dice.

**Prerequisite** Heavy Weaponry 3+.

While tapping strength, throw an ally or Restrained enemy up to 100 feet, dealing damage if they're an enemy.
Steel Feruchemy enables you to store physical speed in your steelmind.
When you Dodge while tapping speed, you can't be grazed.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping speed, spend 1 focus to reuse an action. It must involve a physical test.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While tapping speed or mental speed, spend 1 charge to gain reaction on each character's turn.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While tapping speed, spend 1 charge to gain 2 actions for Brace, Disengage, Interact, Move, or physical tests.
Spend 1 charge before a scene to gain 2 actions or an additional contribution at the start of the scene.
Tap Speed and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to Move each turn as free action once per charge.
Tin Feruchemy grants you the ability to store your senses—typically hearing, sight, smell, taste, and touch—in your tinmind.

**Prerequisite** Heavy Weaponry 1+ or Light Weaponry 1+.

While burning tin or tapping sense, the range of your ranged attacks increases, and you don't raise the stakes on ranged attacks near an ally.
Tap Sense doesn't end Store Sense, and vice versa, as long as you store and tap different senses.

**Prerequisite** Medicine 2+.

While storing your sense of touch, reduce incoming damage and ignore Afflicted, Exhausted, and Slowed.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

Tap Sense and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects, and to apply it to senses up to the charges spent.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Before a sensory trigger, Store Sense and gain an advantage against the triggering effect.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

When you Store Sense, store senses up to your tier. For each additional sense, gain a charge and becoming Diminished [Awareness −1].
Zinc Feruchemy enables you to store mental speed in your zincmind.
While tapping mental speed, your Aid reaction grants a bonus equal to your Feruchemy.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

While tapping mental speed, spend 1 focus to reuse an action. It must involve a cognitive or Awareness test.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While tapping speed or mental speed, spend 1 charge to gain reaction on each character's turn.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

While tapping mental speed, spend 1 charge to gain 2 actions for Ready, Recover, or tests using Awareness, Intellect, or Willpower.
Tap mental speed and spend additional charges to shorten but amplify its effects.

**Prerequisite** Deduction 2+.

Spend 1 charge to have an epiphany about the current scene.
